config_rules.description: List of key request rules. Each rule specifies how to handle keys of a given type and description pattern.

keytype.description: The key type (e.g., user, logon, asymmetric, dns_resolver).

description_pattern.description: Shell-style glob pattern to match against the key description. '*' matches any.

flags.description: Flags passed to the action script. Commonly '-c' (create), '-p' (inherit credentials), etc.

action_script.description: Program to execute when the rule matches (e.g., /sbin/request-key, /bin/true, /bin/false).

args.description: Additional arguments passed to the action script.
